description: K. Mary Margaret Perera v. P.L.P. Ethel Freeda Seneviratne K. Mary Margaret Perera v. P.L.P. Ethel Freeda Seneviratne View More before Hon. Rohini Marasinghe, J.
parties: K. Mary Margaret Perera v. P.L.P. Ethel Freeda Seneviratne K. Mary Margaret Perera v. P.L.P. Ethel Freeda Seneviratne View More
keywords: The Plaintiff-Appellant (the tenant) sought specific performance of an alleged oral agreement to purchase the rented premises, or alternatively reimbursement of expenses incurred on improvements and a right of retention until payment. Held - Appeal dismissed since no valid sale agreement existed as there was no notarially executed written agreement, and the Defendant-Respondent no longer owned the property; Plaintiff also failed to prove that the expenditures were made pursuant to the alleged sale agreement, thus, a tenant cannot recover such expenses outside the framework of the Rent Act.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
